n: On the night of September 21, 1823, the angel Moroni quoted Malachi to young Joseph Smith with an important difference: Elijah would “reveal the Priesthood” — the sealing power — before the Second Coming. Elijah restored these keys in the Kirtland Temple in 1836.

f.w: by the hand of Elijah the prophet
great and dreadful day of the Lord
f.g: the Second Coming — great for the righteous, dreadful for the wicked.

n: Elijah’s mission plants in the hearts of the living the promises God made to their ancestors, turning their hearts toward them. Latter-day Saints see this fulfilled in family history and temple work for the dead.

f.w: the promises made to the fathers
f.g: the covenant blessings promised to ancient patriarchs such as Abraham, including eternal family ties.

f.w: the hearts of the children shall turn to their fathers

n: Without this sealing link between generations, the earth would fail its purpose and be “utterly wasted” at Christ’s coming. Malachi says “smite the earth with a curse”; Moroni’s wording stresses that the purpose of creation would be lost.

f.g: completely ruined; left without its intended purpose.
